title: Book a table
intro: Tables are released thirty days ahead. For parties larger than six, or for the chef's counter, send us a note and we will call you back.

notes.title: Cancellations
notes.text: Let us know twelve hours ahead and there is no charge. The room is small, so a no-show costs us a whole table.

notes.title: Allergies
notes.text: Tell us when you book, not when you sit down. Almost everything can be adapted with a day's notice.

notes.title: Children
notes.text: Welcome at the Sunday lunch service. The evening room is quiet by design.

notes.title: Parking
notes.text: The old quarter is pedestrian after 19:00. The nearest garage is on Rua do Castelo, four minutes on foot.
